} for row in school_flows]

    _group = [row for row in school_chart_rows if row["source"] == _school]
    assert sum(row["count"] for row in _group) == _group[0]["total"]
    assert math.isclose(sum(row["share"] for row in _group), 1)

school_tooltip = [
    alt.Tooltip("source:N", title="本科层次"), alt.Tooltip("target:N", title="申请目标"),
    alt.Tooltip("count:Q", title="投稿数", format=","),
    alt.Tooltip("share:Q", title="组内比例", format=".1%"),
    alt.Tooltip("total:Q", title="本科组总数", format=","),
]

def school_chart_output(chart, caption, *, number, responsive=False):
    # The Sankey fills the article; dense matrix labels retain a fixed canvas.
    alt.renderers.enable("default", embed_options={"renderer": "svg", "actions": False})
    # usermeta overrides marimo's frontend canvas default, unlike renderer options alone.
    if responsive:
        chart = chart.properties(width="container", autosize=alt.AutoSizeParams(type="fit", contains="padding"))
    else:
        chart = chart.properties(width=640)
    chart = (chart.properties(usermeta={"embedOptions": {"renderer": "svg", "actions": False}})
             .configure(background="#ffffff", font="sans-serif")
             .configure_view(stroke=None)
             .configure_axis(labelFontSize=12, titleFontSize=12, grid=False))
    output = mo.ui.altair_chart(chart, chart_selection=False, legend_selection=False)
    if responsive:
        output = mo.vstack([output.style({"width": "100%", "min-width": "480px"})]).style(
            {"width": "100%", "overflow-x": "auto"})
    else:
        output = mo.hstack([output], justify="start").style({"overflow-x": "auto", "max-width": "100%"})
    return figure_output(output, caption, number=number)

#| error: false
# Both columns use the same count scale; only the inter-node gaps differ.
_gap = 65
_extent = 1737 + _gap * (len(target_order) - 1)
_positions = {}
_nodes = []
for _side, _order in [("source", school_order), ("target", target_order)]:
    _cursor = (_extent - 1737 - _gap * (len(_order) - 1)) / 2
    for _label in _order:
        _count = sum(row["count"] for row in school_chart_rows if row[_side] == _label)
        _positions[_side, _label] = _cursor
        _nodes.append({"source": _label if _side == "source" else "",
                       "target": _label if _side == "target" else "",
                       "label": _label, "count": _count, "side": _side,
                       "x": 0.19 if _side == "source" else 0.79,
                       "x2": 0.21 if _side == "source" else 0.81,
                       "y": _cursor, "y2": _cursor + _count,
                       "middle": _cursor + _count / 2,
                       "text_x": 0.175 if _side == "source" else 0.825,
                       "text": f"{_label} · {_count}"})
        _cursor += _count + _gap
_ribbons = []
for _row in school_chart_rows:
    if not _row["count"]:
        continue
    _start = _positions["source", _row["source"]]
    _end = _positions["target", _row["target"]]
    for _step in range(25):
        _t = _step / 24
        # Smoothstep gives horizontal tangents at both ends and constant thickness.
        _blend = _t * _t * (3 - 2 * _t)
        _y = _start + (_end - _start) * _blend
        _ribbons.append({**_row, "x": 0.21 + 0.58 * _t, "y": _y,
                         "y2": _y + _row["count"], "step": _step,
                         "flow": f"{_row['source']} → {_row['target']}"})
    _positions["source", _row["source"]] += _row["count"]
    _positions["target", _row["target"]] += _row["count"]

_flow_hover = alt.selection_point(name="school_flow_hover", fields=["source", "target"],
                                  on="@school_ribbons_marks:pointerover", clear="pointerout", toggle=False)
_node_hover = alt.selection_point(name="school_node_hover", fields=["source", "target"],
                                  on="@school_nodes_marks:pointerover", clear="pointerout", toggle=False)
_active = (
    "(!length(data('school_flow_hover_store')) && !length(data('school_node_hover_store')))"
    " || (length(data('school_flow_hover_store')) && "
    "(datum.source === school_flow_hover.source[0] && datum.target === school_flow_hover.target[0]))"
    " || (length(data('school_node_hover_store')) && "
    "((school_node_hover.source[0] !== '' && datum.source === school_node_hover.source[0])"
    " || (school_node_hover.target[0] !== '' && datum.target === school_node_hover.target[0])))"
)
# Alternate light and dark blues so adjacent groups remain distinguishable.
_palette = ["#082653", "#9bc9ed", "#1558b0", "#64ace6", "#103e8c", "#287fc2", "#bedff3", "#3c57d6"]
_x = alt.X("x:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 1]), axis=None)
_y = alt.Y("y:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[_extent, 0]), axis=None)
_links = alt.Chart(alt.Data(values=_ribbons)).mark_area(orient="vertical").encode(
    x=_x, y=_y, y2="y2:Q", detail="flow:N",
    color=alt.Color("source:N", scale=alt.Scale(domain=school_order, range=_palette), legend=None),
    opacity=alt.condition(_active, alt.value(0.78), alt.value(0.30)),
    tooltip=school_tooltip,
).properties(name="school_ribbons").add_params(_flow_hover)
_node_base = alt.Chart(alt.Data(values=_nodes))
_bars = _node_base.mark_rect().encode(
    x=_x, x2="x2:Q", y=_y, y2="y2:Q",
    color=alt.condition(alt.datum.side == "source",
                        alt.Color("source:N", scale=alt.Scale(domain=school_order, range=_palette), legend=None),
                        alt.value("#244a7c")),
    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("label:N", title="层次"), alt.Tooltip("count:Q", title="投稿数", format=",")],
).properties(name="school_nodes").add_params(_node_hover)
_labels = []
for _side, _align in [("source", "right"), ("target", "left")]:
    _labels.append(_node_base.transform_filter(alt.datum.side == _side)
                   .mark_text(align=_align, baseline="middle", fontSize=11, fill="#17243b")
                   .encode(x=alt.X("text_x:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 1]), axis=None),
                           y=alt.Y("middle:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[_extent, 0]), axis=None), text="text:N"))
school_chart_output(
    (_links + _bars + _labels[0] + _labels[1]).properties(height=470,
        description="本科层次到申请目标的桑基图，连线宽度表示投稿数"),
    "本科背景 → 申请目标。流带宽度表示投稿数，颜色区分本科背景，节点标注总数。"
    "含 3 条目标未填写；流向表示申请意向，不是录取去向。",
    number=1, responsive=True,
)
